seqkit_missing_hint: The seqkit executable was not found. Set its path in Settings, put seqkit on PATH, or place it in the project's bin/ folder.
unofficial_disclaimer: This is an unofficial desktop GUI for SeqKit and is not affiliated with the SeqKit author. Every sequence operation is still performed by the official seqkit command-line program; this application only assembles arguments and shows the results.
seqkit_attribution: SeqKit is written by Wei Shen and distributed under the MIT licence. This project only invokes that command-line program and ships no SeqKit source code.
mismatch_hint: The parameter table was generated from SeqKit {expected} source; the detected binary reports {actual}, so options may not match exactly.
empty_output_hint: Finished without writing anything to standard output
failed_to_start_hint: seqkit could not be launched. Check that the executable path in Settings is correct and the file is not blocked by antivirus software, then try again.
third party licenses: third-party licences are listed in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md

no_stdin_note: when the list is empty seqkit reads a standard input that is already at end-of-file; the interface does not type into it
